title: LA Colossal – Maki-e 01 (Standing)
prompt:
Fine art body painting photography. Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Japanese woman in her early 40s, glossy black hair in a soft chignon with a gold hairpin, natural face with a calm smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly hanging in multiple deep overlapping rolls down toward the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips far wider than the shoulders, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body maki-e lacquer body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. The body painting is the only covering on the body — no garments, no fabric, no kimono, no robes, no bodysuit, no leggings, no stockings. Deep glossy black urushi with natural highlights and subtle brush texture, fine sprinkled gold dust with individual particles visible forming a full moon, autumn grasses, and flying geese, crisp raised gold relief. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Standing in a three-quarter front view, one hand lightly touching her hairpin at shoulder height, the other on her outer hip, torso turned open to the camera. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch knee-high lace-up black lacquer platform stiletto boots with gold-dust detailing and gold eyelets, visible boot edge.
Nails: Extra long almond nails, black with gold powder tips.

Background & Lighting: MANDATORY seamless matte black studio background. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm key with raking side light making the gold dust glitter. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
